name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
author: maria_cooks
description: Creamy Roman pasta made with eggs, pecorino, and crispy guanciale.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water. Fry the guanciale until crisp. Whisk eggs, pecorino, and pepper together. Toss hot pasta with the guanciale, remove from heat, then stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water as needed until creamy. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
author: veggie_priya
description: Tender marinated chicken in a spiced tomato cream sauce.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, ginger, and garlic for at least 1 hour. Sear the chicken in oil until browned, then set aside. Saute the onion until soft, add the remaining spices and tomatoes, and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the cream and chicken and cook for 10 more minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

name: Vegan Chickpea Salad Sandwich
author: veggie_priya
description: A no-cook, protein-packed take on classic chicken salad.
instructions: Roughly mash the chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture. Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, celery, onion, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Spread onto bread and assemble sandwiches.

name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
author: bakerjen
description: Light, tall pancakes perfect for weekend mornings.
instructions: Whisk the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. In another bowl, combine buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine. Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a medium-hot greased griddle until bubbles form, then flip and cook until golden.

name: Beef Tacos
author: chefdave
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and drain the excess fat. Add the taco seasoning and a splash of water, then simmer for 5 minutes. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with beef and top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
author: maria_cooks
description: Ready in 15 minutes with just a handful of ingredients.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink. Pour in the wine and lemon juice and simmer for 1 minute. Stir in the parsley and serve.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
author: bakerjen
description: Chewy in the middle with crisp, golden edges.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190C (375F). Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt together. Cream the butter with both sugars until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla. Gradually mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in the chocolate chips. Drop rounded tablespoons onto lined baking sheets and bake 9 to 11 minutes until golden.

name: Veggie Stir-Fry with Tofu
author: veggie_priya
description: A colorful weeknight stir-fry with crispy tofu.
instructions: Toss the tofu with cornstarch and pan-fry in sesame oil until crisp, then set aside. Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes. Add the tamari and maple syrup, return the tofu to the pan, and toss to coat. Serve over rice.

name: Hearty Beef Chili
author: chefdave
description: A thick, slow-simmered chili that tastes even better the next day.
instructions: Brown the beef with the onion in a large pot, then add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Adjust seasoning and serve with toppings of your choice.

name: Greek Salad
author: maria_cooks
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and olives in a large bowl. Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, and oregano together and pour over the salad. Toss gently, top with the feta, and serve.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
author: chefdave
description: Crispy-skinned roast chicken with lemon, garlic, and thyme.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220C (425F). Pat the chicken dry and rub it all over with the butter and olive oil, then season generously with salt and pepper. Stuff the cavity with the lemon slices, half of the garlic, and the thyme. Scatter the onion, carrots, and remaining garlic in a roasting pan, set the chicken on top, and roast for about 1 hour 15 minutes until the juices run clear. Rest for 15 minutes, then squeeze the lemon juice over the top before carving.

name: Margherita Pizza
author: maria_cooks
description: Simple homemade pizza with a bright tomato sauce and fresh mozzarella.
ingredients: a handful of fresh basil leaves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 250C (475F) with a baking sheet inside. Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, half of the olive oil, oregano, and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes. Stretch the dough on a floured surface, spread with the sauce, and top with the mozzarella. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is blistered and golden. Finish with the basil and a drizzle of the remaining oil.

name: Smoky Shakshuka
author: veggie_priya
description: Eggs poached in a smoky, spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large, deep skillet and saute the onion and pepper for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne and cook for 1 minute. Pour in the tomatoes, season with salt, and simmer for 10 minutes. Make 6 small wells in the sauce, crack an egg into each, cover, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set. Top with the feta and cilantro and serve with bread.

name: Walnut Banana Bread
author: bakerjen
description: Moist, golden banana bread with a handful of walnuts.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175C (350F) and grease a loaf pan. Mix the mashed bananas with the melted butter, then stir in the brown sugar, egg, and vanilla. Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the batter, then fold in the flour until just combined. Fold in the walnuts, pour into the pan, and bake for 55 to 60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
author: maria_cooks
description: Better than takeout, and a great way to use up leftover rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat and cook the shrimp for 2 minutes per side, then remove. Add the remaining vegetable oil and scramble the eggs. Add the garlic and peas and cook for 1 minute, then add the rice and stir-fry for 3 minutes, breaking up any clumps. Return the shrimp, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, and toss. Top with the scallions.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup
author: veggie_priya
description: Velvety tomato soup that pairs perfectly with a grilled cheese.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion for 6 to 8 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the tomatoes, broth, and sugar and simmer for 20 minutes. Blend until smooth, stir in the cream, and season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with the torn basil.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
author: chefdave
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook in the olive oil in a skillet for 6 to 7 minutes per side until cooked through. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice. Toss the romaine with the dressing and lemon juice, then top with the chicken, parmesan, and croutons.

name: Cold Peanut Noodles
author: veggie_priya
description: Sesame-peanut noodles loaded with crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package directions, then rinse under cold water and drain well. Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, maple syrup, lime juice, sesame oil, and garlic with 2 to 3 tablespoons of warm water until smooth. Toss the noodles with the sauce, carrot, and cucumber. Top with the green onions, cilantro, and red pepper flakes.

name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
author: bakerjen
description: Ultra-creamy mac and cheese made from scratch in one pot.
instructions: Cook the macaroni until al dente and drain. In the same pot, melt the butter, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened. Remove from the heat and stir in the cheddar, parmesan, and paprika until melted. Season with salt and pepper, then fold in the macaroni.

name: Black Bean Quesadillas
author: chefdave
instructions: Mash half of the beans with the cumin and lime juice, then stir in the remaining beans and the bell pepper. Spread the mixture over half of each tortilla, top with cheese, and fold over. Cook in a skillet sprayed with cooking spray for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp. Serve with the sour cream and cilantro.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
author: maria_cooks
description: Creamy arborio rice with earthy mushrooms and parmesan.
instructions: Saute the mushrooms in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil until browned, then set aside. Cook the onion in the remaining oil and half of the butter until soft, add the garlic, then stir in the rice for 1 minute. Add the wine and stir until absorbed. Add the warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring often, for about 20 minutes until the rice is creamy. Stir in the mushrooms, remaining butter, parmesan, and parsley, and season to taste.

name: Cinnamon Apple Crumble
author: bakerjen
description: Warm cinnamon apples under a buttery oat topping.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180C (350F). Toss the apples with the lemon juice, granulated sugar, and cinnamon in a baking dish. Rub the butter into the flour, oats, brown sugar, and salt until crumbly, then scatter over the apples. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

name: Spaghetti and Meatballs
author: chefdave
description: Tender baked meatballs in a simple marinara.
instructions: Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic, parsley, oregano, salt, and pepper, then roll into about 16 meatballs. Brown them in the olive oil in a large skillet, pour in the marinara, and simmer covered for 15 minutes until cooked through. Meanwhile, cook the spaghetti until al dente. Toss with the sauce and serve with the meatballs on top.

name: Berry Overnight Oats
author: veggie_priya
description: A make-ahead breakfast that is ready when you wake up.
instructions: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, maple syrup, vanilla, and chia seeds together in a jar, then fold in the blueberries. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 6 hours. Stir and serve cold, adding a splash more milk if it is too thick.

name: Veggie Egg Muffins
author: maria_cooks
description: Grab-and-go breakfast cups, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175C (350F) and spray a 12-cup muffin tin. Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and pepper. Divide the spinach, bell pepper, green onions, cheddar, and feta among the cups, then pour in the egg mixture. Bake for 20 to 22 minutes until set.
